descrizione: A few steps before your mail becomes a list of things to do.

informativa.dati: We read your Gmail messages and store their text and headers encrypted while the mailbox stays connected.
informativa.modelli: Email text is sent to AI models through OpenRouter with your key, only to providers with zero data retention.
informativa.conservazione: Disconnecting a mailbox or deleting your account removes everything derived from it.
informativa.limitedUse: The use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

chiave.spiegazione: All AI analysis runs with your own OpenRouter key. It is verified, stored encrypted and never shown again.
chiave.consiglio: Tip: create a dedicated key with a credit limit. Prompt logging settings on your OpenRouter account stay under your control.

esiti.credito_esaurito: The key is valid but has no credit left.
esiti.errore_temporaneo: OpenRouter could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
esiti.formato_non_valido: This does not look like an OpenRouter key.

contesto.spiegazione: Tell the assistant what matters to you: important senders, what counts as urgent, what is just News & FYI. These are the default directives; edit them freely.

importazione.spiegazione: We analyse the last 14 days of received mail and 30 days of sent mail, newest first. Your home fills in when the analysis is done.
